ENG-G04 point-light shadows. Until now only the directional key light (lights[0]) casts shadows, through cascaded shadow maps (class kke::ShadowMap). Now each point light that casts shadows gets a cube of 6 faces around it (+X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z), each a perspective view a little wider than 90 degrees, drawn into its own tile of a second ShadowMap (the point map): tile = light * ShadowMap::kPointFaces + face. C++20, glm, Vulkan (depth 0..1, clip-space Y flipped by proj[1][1] *= -1.0f like computeLightViewProj). struct LightingUBOData mirrors shaders/lighting_ubo.glsl byte for byte; the GLSL block just gained three members at its end: `vec4 pointShadowOn; mat4 pointShadowViewProj[24]; vec4 pointShadowTiles[24];`. Two edits, nothing else:
1. Your SEARCH block is exactly these lines:
```
    glm::vec4 cascadeScaleOffset[ShadowMap::kCascades]; // cascade c's clip xy = the far cascade's xy * (x, y) + (z, w)
```
and your REPLACE block is those same lines followed by the new lines. Change nothing else; do not copy or move any other line.
The three new members, each with a short `//` comment at the end of its line:
`    glm::vec4 pointShadowOn;` / `    glm::mat4 pointShadowViewProj[ShadowMap::kMaxPointShadows * ShadowMap::kPointFaces];` / `    glm::vec4 pointShadowTiles[ShadowMap::kMaxPointShadows * ShadowMap::kPointFaces];`
2. The static_assert line below the struct: add `+ 16 + ShadowMap::kMaxPointShadows * ShadowMap::kPointFaces * (64 + 16)` to the right-hand side of the `==` (before `, "must match shaders/lighting_ubo.glsl"`), and directly after that static_assert line add the line
`static_assert(ShadowMap::kMaxPointShadows == Lighting::kMaxLights, "one point map slot per light");`
